authorization: Parent task: only the two acceptance-driver Workspace adaptations; isolated Node VM <=15 minutes, no production credentials, models, UI/server changes, ref updates or workflows.

behavior.factory: Every existing /api/factory/* HTTP request, including read, create, PATCH, approval, cancel and DELETE/restore cleanup, sends the selected and previously verified Personal Workspace in x-mikka-workspace-id. Conflicting existing header, query workspaceId or body workspaceId is refused before fetch. Ordinary session cookies, Origin, redirect:error, server membership and business-target validation remain in force.
behavior.ownerIdle: Before each existing preparation/restoration mutation gate, read the normal authenticated /api/workspace inventory; validate nonempty, unique typed choices with exactly the selected Personal Workspace; explicitly select each choice for pollThreads and pollTaskRuns; re-read and compare the same ID/kind set after the finite scan. No switchWorkspace mutation is added by the scan.

bounds.requestTimeout: min(existing 30 seconds, remaining overall scan deadline)

behavior.resultProof: Both readers must return complete arrays, exact live.ownerId/workspaceId and known status/valid unique run IDs. Threads additionally require a 32-hex version and full positions manifest matching items. Delta/unchanged responses, pagination/truncation flags, >=200 rows, invalid scope, HTTP errors or inventory set changes block.
behavior.timeProof: Nonempty responses must carry a valid positive server expiry; a known 30-day expiry at/before completion blocks. Scan time cannot go backwards or reach its 30-second deadline. No row is filtered out to make an active list look idle.
behavior.limits: Authorized active Workspaces and only the original readers' 30-day visible windows are observed. An unpaginated inventory response is complete under the fixed P061 contract. A server that silently violates that contract is not independently proven complete by the driver. This is not an atomic account fence and says nothing about runs older than 30 days or inaccessible Workspaces. Existing account exclusivity and live gates remain required.

riskReview.alignment: Two driver defects from P061 source review are addressed without modifying normal product behavior or permissions.
riskReview.impact: Additional reads occur only at existing preparation/restoration idle gates, bounded to 66 reads/30s per scan. Server defaults and live/read timing are unchanged.
riskReview.verification: Actual native Node tests establish driver behavior against source-shaped fixtures; parent independently reviewed P061 response contracts. Full CI and any eventual real production case remain separate.
riskReview.rollback: Only two source files change, with no schema/data migration. Reverting to the old driver would restore its incomplete multi-Workspace idle assumption; do not use such a revert to authorize preparation against P0.
riskReview.errorDetection: Closed errors keep account/session cleanup visible, refuse incomplete scans, preserve uncertain writes and never retry using implicit Workspace authority. Non-atomic races remain bounded by the existing account window rather than a claimed new lock.

conclusion: Ready for parent source review and later integration; no branch/ref/CI/production action was performed.
